probe_data: 1000 random-policy transitions from training seeds 1-5, five completed 200-step episodes; no validation, development, confirmation, or G12 test data used
force_loss: SmoothL1(beta=1.0 nominal N), rho-weighted across the same three model rollout steps, mean over batch and divided by horizon as for original terms
rationale: A single 0.5 coefficient gives nontrivial gradient to the new force head and shared encoder/dynamics while its measured initial contribution is about 5.6% of the original total, far below the largest existing weighted terms. Later loss magnitudes will be monitored without coefficient retuning.
force_target_probe: 409/1000 positive-force steps, 0/1000 above F_lim, Q90 1.452 N, Q99 2.128 N, maximum 2.328 N; high-force learning must arise from later on-policy exploration, not this scale probe
